purpose: Post-investigation comparison of candidate technique classes; not a prespecified implementation plan
search_type: Targeted, non-exhaustive primary-source scoping search, not a systematic review
verification_level: Publisher/author primary pages and abstracts; selected full-text passages, not full independent reproduction
search_families: OpenIE6 / REBEL / relation extraction / source-grounded candidate generation
StarE / hyper-relational representation / condition and procedural context
RotatE / SimKGC / contrastive and self-supervised graph completion
AutoSchemaKG / dynamic schema induction / 2025-2026 LLM-assisted knowledge construction
Relation-aware prompting / imperfect relational context / recent diagnostic counterevidence
selection_rule: Representative primary methods spanning the observed problems plus counterevidence; no ranking by architectural complexity or claimed benchmark improvement
excluded_as_support: OpenReview browser challenge page as a substitute for RotatE content

sources.title: OpenIE6: Iterative Grid Labeling and Coordination Analysis for Open Information Extraction
sources.verified_claim: Iterative grid labeling and explicit coordination analysis for OpenIE.
sources.local_limit: English open extraction is not a pump-specific applicability or normative entailment solution.

sources.title: REBEL: Relation Extraction By End-to-end Language generation
sources.local_limit: Generated triples still require source addresses, type/role checks and qualifier preservation.

sources.title: A Dataset for Hyper-Relational Extraction and a Cube-Filling Approach
sources.verified_claim: HyperRED and CubeRE jointly consider main relations and qualifiers extracted from text.
sources.local_limit: Its general-domain qualifiers do not establish performance on negation, obligations, pump models or table row guards.

sources.title: Deep Entity Matching with Pre-Trained Language Models
sources.verified_claim: Ditto casts entity matching as a sequence-pair classification problem using pretrained language models.
sources.local_limit: Five local lexical groups do not justify fine-tuning or provide sufficient hard identity labels.

sources.title: Message Passing for Hyper-Relational Knowledge Graphs
sources.verified_claim: StarE incorporates qualifier key-value pairs in hyper-relational graph encoding.
sources.local_limit: An encoder cannot recover missing source qualifiers merely because a graph is sparse; this is one optional class, not a selected model.

sources.title: RotatE: Knowledge Graph Embedding by Relational Rotation in Complex Space
sources.verified_claim: Rotation-based entity/relation representations support link prediction and relation-pattern modeling.
sources.local_limit: A high link score does not identify an independent technical-document witness or prove a new causal fact.

sources.title: SimKGC: Simple Contrastive Knowledge Graph Completion with Pre-trained Language Models
sources.verified_claim: Text-based graph completion with contrastive training and several negative sampling sources.
sources.local_limit: Local negatives are not established true negatives, and absent links must not automatically become negative facts.

sources.title: Anytime bottom-up rule learning for large-scale knowledge graph completion
sources.venue: The VLDB Journal 33, 131-161; online 2023; publisher flags a 2025 correction
sources.verified_claim: AnyBURL generalizes sampled graph paths into Horn rules and discusses confidence estimation.
sources.local_limit: Local semantic graph sparsity and unverified entity alignment undermine rule support; a rule explanation is not independent source evidence.

sources.title: Knowledge Vault: A Web-Scale Approach to Probabilistic Knowledge Fusion
sources.verified_claim: Combines extracted evidence and prior knowledge using supervised probabilistic fusion.
sources.local_limit: Current source-family agreement data and independent correctness labels cannot support locally calibrated truth probabilities.

sources.title: RARR: Researching and Revising What Language Models Say, Using Language Models
sources.verified_claim: Retrieves attribution evidence and revises unsupported generated content.
sources.local_limit: Document attribution is not automatically correct role/condition binding; repeated AI judgment remains AI evaluation.

sources.title: AutoSchemaKG: Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction through Dynamic Schema Induction from Web-Scale Corpora
sources.verified_claim: LLM-based autonomous extraction and dynamic schema induction for entities and events.
sources.local_limit: Web-scale construction claims do not justify replacing a frozen pump schema or treating a schema-field omission as a newly discovered relation.

sources.title: Relation-Aware Prompting Makes Large Language Models Effective Zero-shot Relation Extractors
sources.verified_claim: Two-stage relation-aware prompting forms a zero-shot relation extraction approach.
sources.local_limit: It is a candidate generic control if another experiment is approved, not evidence that current pump misses require a specialized algorithm.

sources.title: Does Pre-trained Language Model Actually Infer Unseen Links in Knowledge Graph Completion?
sources.verified_claim: Separates inference and memorization concerns in pretrained-language-model graph completion evaluation.
sources.local_limit: Supports an evaluation warning, not a finding that all pretrained KGC is memorization or useless.

sources.title: End-to-End Graph Retrieval Pipeline for Specialized Domains
sources.verified_claim: Instructional-text hyper-relational construction preserves conditions and procedural context; its reported comparison does not show graph retrieval universally beating text retrieval.
sources.local_limit: Horse-training domain and expert-validated QA do not transfer to pump diagnostic efficacy; workshop evidence, not a universal result.

sources.title: Failure Modes of Imperfect Relational Context in LLM Document Extraction
sources.verified_claim: Exploratory FUNSD experiments examine downstream damage from wrong or missing relational context.
sources.local_limit: Form extraction, corpus-developed prompts and single generations; only a caution against assuming added graph edges are beneficial.

route_comparison.class: Source extraction and evidence-guided candidate recovery
route_comparison.fit: Relevant only after a source proposition is shown absent at generation, not merely excluded at release.
route_comparison.prerequisite: A source-first set of semantically resolved omissions and an equal input/resource budget.
route_comparison.engineering_control: Original-candidate replay, quote/context binding and terminology release analysis.
route_comparison.decision: INCONCLUSIVE: this round establishes release/representation issues, not a sufficient set of genuine generation omissions.

route_comparison.class: Contextual relation/event extraction and n-ary or hyper-relational representation
route_comparison.fit: Can represent operator scope, equipment applicability and procedure branches if they are first extracted correctly.
route_comparison.prerequisite: Explicit task/schema contract plus varied, independently evaluated source/role/condition cases.
route_comparison.engineering_control: Literal source retention, native row/column context and explicit qualifier serialization.
route_comparison.decision: INCONCLUSIVE: most relevant problem family for further isolation, no encoder or new model selected.

route_comparison.class: Entity resolution, multilingual canonicalization and contextual disambiguation
route_comparison.fit: Potentially useful for hard same-name/different-object or cross-lingual identities.
route_comparison.prerequisite: Adequate hard match/nonmatch cases and equipment/component scopes.
route_comparison.engineering_control: Typed alias dictionary and nominalization; preserve unresolved relief-valve referents.
route_comparison.decision: NO-GO for claiming a new learned aligner from these five groups alone.

route_comparison.class: Rule learning, symbolic constraints and probabilistic logical reasoning
route_comparison.fit: Useful if repeated, context-compatible premises and source-supported conclusions are established.
route_comparison.prerequisite: Aligned entities, repeated rule support and independently witnessed candidate conclusions.
route_comparison.engineering_control: Do not assume causal transitivity or turn nonconnectivity into positive missing-edge labels.
route_comparison.decision: NO-GO on the current topology-only motivation; broad class not rejected in principle.

route_comparison.class: Graph embeddings, graph neural encoding and text-contrastive/self-supervised completion
route_comparison.fit: Ranks plausible links or aligns descriptions, but does not itself establish document entailment.
route_comparison.prerequisite: Source-supported missing facts, meaningful hard negatives, leakage-resistant splits and adequate graph signal.
route_comparison.engineering_control: Compare version membership, existing aliases and direct text evidence before learning.
route_comparison.decision: NO-GO for prescribing B2/GNN now; no current independent missing-edge evaluation frame.

route_comparison.class: Probabilistic evidence fusion and source reliability/truth discovery
route_comparison.fit: Relevant when genuinely independent source statements agree or conflict under matched scopes.
route_comparison.prerequisite: More independent-source overlap, dependency handling and trustworthy calibration references.
route_comparison.engineering_control: Source-family deduplication, object binding and set-union metadata projection.
route_comparison.decision: INCONCLUSIVE: zero recorded multi-family claims and only one condition-supported additional evidence candidate.

route_comparison.class: LLM-assisted source discovery, attribution/revision and schema induction
route_comparison.fit: Can suggest source-grounded alternatives or schema omissions while retaining evidence pointers.
route_comparison.prerequisite: Bounded source access/cost, replayable caches and independent assessment of hallucination/condition changes.
route_comparison.engineering_control: No closed-book candidate may enter the formal graph without a source witness; keep current schema frozen.
route_comparison.decision: Candidate category only; no automatic superiority or local factual accuracy established.

route_comparison.class: Engineering-only data, provenance-view and schema/interface repair
route_comparison.fit: Directly addresses observed interface/naming/scope defects before attributing them to algorithm limits.
route_comparison.prerequisite: User authorization for a separate repair and regression round; not applied in this investigation.
route_comparison.engineering_control: Versioned adapters, record joins, source-preserving aggregation and explicit scope checks.
route_comparison.decision: GO as scoped engineering candidates, not as claimed core algorithmic innovation.

conclusion: Literature supplies alternative classes and important counterevidence, but does not change the local INCONCLUSIVE decision or justify a new model. Stop after report.
